assembly_notes: The root is always one source-backed housing. structural_family owns the housing topology together with its compatible grounds receiver, so a drawer can only exist behind a genuinely cut cavity with four rails and a cup can only exist below a matching open socket. The adjustment collar, crank, free-spinning grip, optional receiver and optional lid are moving children assembled with registered axis interfaces. Folding-top-crank source detail is delivered in its deployed working pose as one rigid clevis-and-arm crank plus a free grip. No overlap allowance is used; isolated-part allowances are restricted to joint-retained members separated by intentional running clearance. Hinged top drives derive extra height from the hopper envelope, and cup-family table clamps consume a body-side seat above the removable cup.

required_author_checks: drive and adjustment use source axes
drawer family has real cut cavity rails and hollow tray
cup family has matching open receiver and source motion
cup family has matching open receiver and source motion
hinged cover has slot captured knuckles and bounded opening

candidates.name: turned_wood_integrated
candidates.notes: Integrated grounds body; no detachable receiver is emitted.

candidates.evidence: Source 002: fine-ribbed black travel cylinder above a removable open tapered grounds cup.
candidates.name: ribbed_travel_cup
candidates.notes: Housing owns the lower guide/socket and the cup's downward release joint.

candidates.evidence: Threaded-cup fork: stepped lower socket, engagement lip and readable knurled cup perimeter.
candidates.name: ribbed_threaded_cup
candidates.notes: Receiver uses a bounded multi-turn revolute unscrewing motion.

candidates.evidence: Source 003: rounded wooden cabinet, dark bowl and a square front grounds drawer with central knob.
candidates.name: wood_cabinet_drawer
candidates.notes: The cabinet is cut through its front wall before the hollow drawer and four guide rails are added.

candidates.evidence: Square-wood-box fork combined with the source-002 coaxial open removable cup interface.

candidates.notes: Square upper shell and cup socket are one compatible structural family.

candidates.notes: A rectangular landing is fused to the cylinder before the real drawer cavity is subtracted.

candidates.evidence: Source 001: vertical shaft, thin horizontal crank, end pin and turned free-spinning grip.

candidates.evidence: Side-crank fork: side shaft passage, offset vertical arm and coaxial free-spinning grip.

candidates.evidence: Source countertop grinders sit on a complete stable housing footprint.
